notes.title: The Backworld Update: Upgraded Overworld Depth!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I've been grinding and The Backworld is looking awesome! I've got a demo that should be coming out sometime this year.



In terms of new gameplay mechanics I've been upping the number of options and strategies at your disposal while exploring in the overworld. 



Enemies now also are damaged by hazards like traps and projectiles created by enemies or toxic ground/air. So you can hurt enemies or even fully defeat them before a battle starts if you can get them to run into these hazards.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323989/db91e2b50557f3dfa68c2cbc7d99294b14ae7f61.png"]

I have also upgraded the stealth system, you can now crouch near objects in behind the line of sight of enemies to avoid them. The "stealth upgrade" Sandra grants you now allows you to stealth past enemies even if they should be able to see you, and it's basically a very limited resource that replenishes at checkpoints.



On the super hardcore modes you're really going to have to use these mechanics well to survive! I'm also probably adding in usable items so you can set down traps or shoot projectiles in the world yourself. 



That's it for now!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323989/7840947f473835f62d933abc2e3611db62e6f11a.png"]

notes.title: The Backworld Update: Sanity, Hunger, and Dialogue!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! The Backworld has been coming along great! I've been writing an insane amount of dialogue for all the companions, especially their reactions to events. I've also put together a banter system where companions will randomly talk to each other while exploring. I wanna make sure every character feels alive!

I'm also going to be adding a sanity and hunger system for those looking for a more hardcore challenge! 

As your sanity gets lower you'll start seeing hallucinations, and there will be some debuffs like a reduced vision range. But who knows... maybe when you're insane you might find some bonus content?

In terms of hunger, it will effect your stats and how long you can sprint. I'm also adding lots of gross healing/food items that will reduce your sanity if you decide to use them. Ever eaten an eyeball?

If these hardcore features aren't your thing, don't worry. I have separated the survival horror and RPG difficulty elements as their own difficulties. So you can for example choose a really hard difficulty for the RPG battles, but a low difficulty for the survival horror elements if you don't find managing your resources fun. So the hunger and sanity systems can be opted out of if that's your preference. 

That's it for this month!

notes.title: New Patch
notes.notes:
Minor bug fixes.

Added two portals that lead back to previous areas before the Slime fight. In case you didn't explore much and find items, you can easily backtrack now to find some. Also added a few more items in those previous areas.

Added three portals in the same place that lead to some tiny areas that hint at future enemies / dungeons in the game. They also give you some extra items / exp, just to make sure you are strong enough to beat the Slime. (might have some new bugs in these areas)

You should be able to just load your old save and find them.
